product.name: Vistaro
product.tagline: Every animation type, played live on one screen

theme.font: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

rail.title: Pick an animation type
rail.subtitle: Each scenario demonstrates one step action from anim.config.json, on the same mockup.

scenarios.label: Everything at once
scenarios.blurb: A 20-second tour through highlight, click, type, camera, animate and fade.

scenarios.label: Click
scenarios.blurb: Cursor travel, spotlight, ripple — and the page's own handlers run.

scenarios.label: Type
scenarios.blurb: Character-by-character typing with real key events.

scenarios.label: Focus
scenarios.blurb: el.focus() — the page's own focus ring lights up.

scenarios.label: Hover
scenarios.blurb: The cursor glides onto elements and their :hover styles respond.

scenarios.label: Press
scenarios.blurb: A real keyboard key: Enter, Tab, or a chord like Control+K.

scenarios.label: Highlight
scenarios.blurb: A spotlight pulse that says notice this — no click.

scenarios.label: Camera
scenarios.blurb: Push in, glide between details, pull back — a camera on rails.

scenarios.label: Scroll
scenarios.blurb: Smooth-scroll a buried element into view, in a container or the page.

scenarios.label: Fade in
scenarios.blurb: Reveal pre-hidden elements: a card, a toast, the whole page.

scenarios.label: Transition screen
scenarios.blurb: Cross-fade between two screens authored in one file.

scenarios.label: Animate
scenarios.blurb: Free-form Web Animations: transforms, stagger, seven easings.
